summary: Tested Super Admin client report feature: clicking active client cards opens a report modal with 4 stats (Drivers, Parked Now, Tips Today, Parked Today). All backend API tests passed (5/6, 1 minor failure). All frontend UI tests passed.

minor.issue: Returns 500 instead of 401/403 for invalid JWT tokens. Should return proper auth error.

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/super-admin/clients/{client_id}/report returns correct structure with num_drivers, cars_parked_now, tips_today, cars_parked_today
Backend: Report endpoint returns 404 for non-existent client_id
Backend: Report endpoint returns 401/403 for unauthenticated requests
Backend: All numeric values in report are non-negative
Backend: All clients with valid client_id have accessible reports
Frontend: Clicking active client card opens report modal (data-testid=client-report-modal)
Frontend: Modal shows client name and admin name in header
Frontend: Modal shows 4 stats with correct data-testids: report-num-drivers, report-cars-parked-now, report-tips-today, report-cars-parked-today
Frontend: Close button (data-testid=close-report-modal) closes the modal
Frontend: Clicking backdrop closes the modal
Frontend: Delete button click does NOT open modal (stopPropagation working correctly)
Frontend: Clicking inactive client does NOT open modal
Frontend: Active clients show ChevronRight icon indicating clickability
Frontend: Inactive clients are dimmed and have no ChevronRight icon
action_items: MINOR: Backend should return 401/403 instead of 500 for invalid JWT tokens on the report endpoint
seed_data_creation: None - used existing client data (Taj Hotel, Empire)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Client report feature is fully working. Key data-testids: client-report-modal (modal container), close-report-modal (close button), report-num-drivers, report-cars-parked-now, report-tips-today, report-cars-parked-today (4 stat cards). The modal opens when clicking active client cards and closes via close button or backdrop click. Delete button has stopPropagation to prevent modal from opening. Inactive clients cannot be clicked. Tips data is placeholder (always 0) as noted in the review request.
